{{Quote|Private Krieger can't stop shaking. Gialto thinks he shot his husband. This Dread Master stuff, man&hellip;|Sergeant Trila|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Gialto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] who was part of [[Strike Team Oricon]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force assembled during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to eliminate the [[Dread Masters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]. Gialto was [[Marriage/Legends|married]], and when he was stranded in the wastes of Oricon after part of the strike force crashed on the moon, he experienced hallucinations that he shot his [[Gialto's husband|husband]]. Gialto was eventually rescued, but remained mentally traumatized in the immediate aftermath.
